details: This package is a republished fork of the WhatsApp Web (Baileys) socket library that covertly enrols the consumer's linked WhatsApp account into a channel and brands outgoing traffic. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the socket factory arms a setTimeout(5000) callback that issues the WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel JID 120363420757607688@newsletter; the call is wrapped in an empty try/catch, so every account that connects through this library is silently subscribed to that channel with no user action and no API call from the integrating application. lib/Socket/luxu.js additionally rewrites forwarded and poll content with the author's newsletter identity: newsletterName "D | 7eppeli-Exloration" plus newsletterJid 120363421563597486@newsletter, with 120363399602691477@newsletter used as a default value, so messages sent through the library carry that channel's branding. The package publishes under a scope that is not the canonical publisher of the "baileys" name and points its homepage/repository at its own npm page. The preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only checks that the running Node.js version is 20 or newer. The package reads no environment variables and no credential, token or auth-state files, and its only network destinations besides WhatsApp endpoints are a raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com URL used for an upstream version check and caller-supplied media URLs.
